business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Microfluidic Cartridges and Immunoassay Analyzers

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (unitary national jurisdiction with no sub-state commercial registry distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (continental European tradition with commercial codification under the Código de Comercio)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Andean Community Decision 578 (Common Regime for Treatment of Foreign Capital and Trademarks, Patents, Licenses and Royalties)
Colombia-United States Trade Promotion Agreement (in force 2012)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 1121 de 2006 (AML framework); Ley 526 de 1999 (UIAF creation); Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada); Decreto-Ley 410 de 1971 (Código de Comercio); Decreto 830 de 2021 (SARLAFT - Sistema de Administración del Riesgo de Lavado de Activos, Financiación del Terrorismo y Proliferación de Armas); Resolución DIAN 000164 de 2020 (UBO declaration Form 1823); Circular Externa 201 de 2020 de la Superintendencia de Sociedades; Circular Básica Jurídica 029 de 2014 de la Superintendencia Financiera; Ley 2195 de 2022 (transparency and anti-corruption measures applicable to beneficial ownership); Ley 599 de 2000 arts. 323, 345 and 346 (money laundering and financing of terrorism offenses); FATF Recommendations 10, 24 and 25 as implemented by national regulation.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (UBO declarations filed with DIAN via Form 1823 are confidential tax information under Estatuto Tributario arts. 583-586; SuperSociedades and UIAF access for AML/CFT supervision; no public disclosure of natural-person UBO holdings in the commercial registry)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence (Certificado de Existencia y Representación) of the non-resident corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the jurisdiction of incorporation of the foreign shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized corporate resolution authorizing the incorporation of the Colombian SAS and appointing its legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public and corporate secretary of the foreign parent company

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passports and proof of residence of natural-person UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent issuing authority of the UBO's country of nationality and residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization for non-Hague Convention states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special Power of Attorney (poder especial) granted by the foreign shareholder to the Colombian attorney executing the incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization for non-Hague Convention states

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all UBOs, directors, legal representatives, and authorized signatories against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Colombian national judicial and administrative registries; PEP identification and risk rating must follow SuperSociedades Circular Externa 201 de 2020 and UIAF typology guidance; PEPs, family members, and close associates trigger enhanced due diligence; all screening records must be archived for at least ten years and negative hits must be resolved by a documented legal opinion before executing the incorporation deed.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) at www.rues.org.co, accessed operationally through the competent Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá digital name-clearance tool in the SIID platform)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Spanish is the official language (Constitución Política art. 10); the registered denomination must be expressed in Latin-script Spanish or contain a clearly distinguishable technical or acronym element; foreign-language or transliterated names are admitted only for protected foreign trademarks or internationally recognized technical terms and remain subject to the Chamber of Commerce phonetic and conceptual similarity review against existing registrations.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant must file a recurso de reposición before the competent Cámara de Comercio within ten business days (Ley 1437 de 2011 arts. 74-76) and, in subsidio, a recurso de apelación to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio; judicial review before the Consejo de Estado may follow within two months after the final administrative decision; a parallel alternative name reservation should be filed simultaneously to prevent incorporation delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Low acceptance: a virtual administrative office may satisfy the registered-domicile formality under Ley 1258 de 2008, but the ISIC 3250 in vitro diagnostic manufacturing scope requires a physical industrial plant to obtain and maintain INVIMA Good Manufacturing Practices (BPM) compliance and sanitary registration; the manufacturing address must be evidenced by lease, title, or authorized possession and cannot be replaced by a virtual office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High, quantified at greater than 70% probability within the first twelve months of operations: INVIMA must conduct a Good Manufacturing Practices audit as a prerequisite to the sanitary registration of in vitro diagnostic medical devices; unannounced inspections by INVIMA, the Ministry of Health, or municipal industrial safety authorities remain possible at any time; inspectors will verify physical premises, equipment, quality systems, and consistency between the registered address and actual manufacturing site.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration duty with the Chamber of Commerce for the commercial registry of the SAS

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Impuesto de registro (registration tax) on the incorporation act

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille of four foreign corporate and individual documents under the Hague Apostille Convention of 1961
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority of the shareholders' country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market tariff per apostille, ranging from US$20 to US$40 depending on the issuing jurisdiction

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation (traductor oficial) of foreign documents into Spanish for the registry and INVIMA file
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator authorized by the Colombian Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal drafting of statutory bylaws (estatutos), incorporation resolution, and UBO-piercing legal opinion
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for full-service cross-border SAS incorporation with due diligence

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT pre-incorporation compliance bundle: UBO Form 1823 preparation, PEP and sanctions screening, and SARLAFT gap report for the future obliged entity
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Retained Colombian AML/CFT compliance practice with licensed attorney
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for a medium-risk manufacturing scope (ISIC 3250, enhanced risk tier)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RUT (Registro Único Tributario) application support at DIAN and e-signature procurement for the legal representative

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consulate statutory fee schedule and courier market rate

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. regime), Arts. 3-9, 17-20; Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), Arts. 110, 353-356; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015 (mercantile registration); Decreto 2266 de 2022 (medical devices, as applicable to corporate purpose evidence).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – Registro Mercantil / Registro Único Empresarial (RUES)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento privado de constitución (private constitutive deed) with authenticated signatures, filed via RUES/RegistroLibre; public deed (escritura pública) before a Notary is mandatory only when in-kind contributions include real estate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital ($0) under Ley 1258 de 2008; shareholders freely set subscribed capital, payable upon incorporation or deferred within a maximum term of two (2) years; in-kind contributions require appraisal attached to the constitutive document; contributions of real estate require public deed and inscription in the Oficina de Registro de Instrumentos Públicos. No escrow account is required for cash contributions.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION No. 001 OF THE INCORPORATING BOARD OF [S.A.S.] WHEREAS the constitutive document of the S.A.S. has been executed and the capital structure approved: 1. SHARE SUBSCRIPTION: The shares subscribed are ratified and the subscribed, paid-up and pending portions are recorded in the shareholders' register. 2. REGISTERED OFFICE: The registered office is fixed at Carrera [X] No. [Y], Bogotá D.C., within the jurisdiction of the Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá. 3. APPOINTMENTS: [Full Name] is appointed legal representative and [Full Name] alternate, with full powers for representation, tax enrollment and banking operations. 4. AUTHORIZATION: The representative is authorized to obtain the RUT, register the company, and complete all formation formalities. Certified by the chairperson and secretary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial registration with the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – Registro Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the constitutive document and annexes in person or via the RegistroLibre electronic portal; pay the registration tariff (derechos de inscripción) calculated on the declared assets; upon approval, obtain the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (C.E.R.L.), which evidences legal personality.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a requirement (requerimiento), the applicant has one month to correct the observations; file a written response with the missing annexes and obtain a new resolution; registration is effective retroactively to the date of initial filing if corrected timely.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax enrollment and RUT issuance (NIT assignment)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (online portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The legal representative or attorney applies online through the DIAN 'Sociedades' service using the Chamber-issued C.E.R.L.; the system assigns a NIT and generates the RUT; elect the general income tax regime and state the applicable obligation codes, including industry and commerce tax (ICA) and VAT responsibilities as relevant to IVD manufacturing sales.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (C.E.R.L.)
Identification document of the legal representative
Electronic signature token (certificado digital) if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUT application is rejected or deferred, reconcile the data with the Chamber certificate and submit a correction request through the RUT 'Actualización' module; once discrepancies are cured, the DIAN issues the final RUT electronically.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank account opening and foreign investment registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank and Banco de la República (exchange office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate checking account with the chosen bank and deposit/subscribe the paid-in capital; if non-resident shareholders remit equity, file the Declaración de Cambio (Form 2) and register the direct foreign investment through the bank or the Banco de la República BPM portal to obtain the Registro de Inversiones Internacionales; maintain the wire evidence (SWIFT/TT) in the corporate file.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (C.E.R.L.)
RUT and NIT of the company
Identification and passport of legal representatives
Proof of capital deposit or SWIFT/TT incoming transfer
Foreign exchange declaration (Form 2) – if foreign capital injection
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the foreign investment registration is filed after the statutory deadline, apply for 'registro tardío' under the Banco de la República procedure, which may trigger late-filing fines; after correction, the certificate of registration is issued with the updated filing date.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: INVIMA – Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos, Medical Devices Directorate
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro Sanitario de Dispositivos Médicos de Uso Humano (Class IIB automated IVD analyzers and microfluidic cartridges) and Certificado de Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (BPM) for the manufacturing establishment, issued under Decreto 2266 de 2022

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) – e.g., CAR Cundinamarca; ANLA only for projects under the national licensing list
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration/permit tier – Plan de Gestión de Residuos Peligrosos (RESPEL) and Permiso de Vertimientos; full EIA (Diagnóstico Ambiental de Alternativas) not required for low-impact IVD assembly operations
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge limits per Resolución 0631 de 2015; air emission and VOC thresholds per Resolución 2254 de 2017; hazardous waste tracking, storage, and disposal per Decreto 4741 de 2005 and Decreto 1076 de 2015; occupational air quality within WHO/ACGIH UV exposure benchmarks for reagent handling.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Cumplimiento de Requisitos de Seguridad Humana y Prevención contra Incendios from the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos; structural load and municipal land-use endorsement (Certificado de Uso de Suelo) from the Curaduría Urbana or Alcaldía; mandatory SG-SST occupational health and safety program registration and ARL affiliation under Decreto 1072 de 2015 and Ley 1562 de 2012.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — portal: www.dian.gov.co; electronic services via MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicio y Control Automatizado)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must appoint a local legal representative or agent and file the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) application with DIAN through the MUISCA portal or at DIAN offices, providing the foreign incorporation certificate (apostilled), the powers of attorney, and local address / agent details, to obtain a NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) with a numeric code beginning 900/901 for foreign-owned entities; the NIT is issued immediately upon RUT registration and the entity becomes subject to periodic filing obligations
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists under Colombian law. An S.A.S. may elect: (i) the Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE) under Law 1943/2018 if gross revenues do not exceed 80,000 UVT, subject to activity eligibility and opt-in before the tax period; (ii) the BIC (Sociedad de Beneficio e Interés Colectivo) designation for corporate purposes, which does not alter tax classification; and (iii) application of tax treaty benefits (including the Colombia-Spain double taxation treaty and Pacific Alliance provisions) via the beneficial-owner procedure before DIAN. Hybrid mismatch rules under Law 1819/2016 (Art. 56-3 ET) and CFC rules under Art. 882 ET apply mandatory adjustments and require no election

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general sales threshold — any entity engaged in the sale of taxable goods or services, or importing goods, must register in the RUT and in the VAT regime (régimen común). Small natural persons may qualify for the simplified regime only if not S.A.S. corporate entities and if they meet the 3,500 UVT gross revenue cap (2025: COP 3,500 × UVT 47,065 = COP 164,727,500); S.A.S. entities are always in the common regime irrespective of turnover, and e-invoicing obligation applies regardless of revenue level
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory since 2019-2021 for all taxpayers: e-invoicing via DIAN-accredited software providers (facturación electrónica) requires real-time validation through MUISCA web-services (API), issuance of the XML invoice (factura electrónica de venta — FE) with a CUFE/CUDS verification code, and immediate transmission of a copy to DIAN, with digital stamping (QR + CUFE code); the 'Régimen de Facturación Electrónica' also mandates the electronic 'nota crédito/débito' and the 'Documento Soporte en Adquisiciones' for purchases from non-invoicing parties

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods legally defined under Art. 481 ET (customs exports) are zero-rated (rate 0%) and confer a right to VAT credit refund (devolución de saldos a favor) on direct and indirect inputs; services rendered to non-residents 'from Colombian territory for use exclusively abroad' (Art. 481(e) ET) and services associated with exported goods (Art. 481(a) ET) also qualify if performed directly by the exporter, and the manufacturing/assembly of medical devices for export under an international commercialization regime qualifies provided the goods physically leave Colombia and the foreign currency is properly collected
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración de Exportación (DEX/BL) — electronic customs export declaration accepted via MUISCA
Bill of Lading (B/L) or Airway Bill evidencing shipment from Colombia
Commercial invoice (factura comercial) issued by the exporter
Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas / Declaración de Cambio (form 634.1) evidencing FX receipt from abroad

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia), which administers the foreign-exchange control regime under Law 9/1991 and Decree 2245/2011, operating through licensed Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario (IMCs) supervised by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC), with the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) enforcing customs and exchange-linked tax obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) is fully convertible under a floating, market-determined exchange rate. Colombia does not impose prior-approval exchange controls, but statutorily requires both current-account and capital-account operations with non-residents to be channeled through IMCs and reported to the Banco de la República on statutory Declaraciones de Cambio. For the CO_SAS, the practical convertibility hurdles are: (i) foreign direct investment must be registered via Formulario No. 2 to create the legal right to future dividend remittances and capital repatriation; (ii) current-account payments (royalties, services, dividends) require underlying commercial documentation; and (iii) dividend outflows to non-resident shareholders attract 5% withholding tax at the shareholder level when paid from taxed corporate earnings, with higher taxation for distributions sourced from exempt income or from unregistered investments. Non-channeling or late registration triggers fines and sanctions under the Régimen Cambiario and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Colombia imposes no mandatory conversion ratio or forced surrender of export receipts; the legal duty is repatriation and channeling through the foreign-exchange market. Export proceeds from IVD equipment, microfluidic cartridges and immunoassay analyzers must be collected and received by the exporter within six (6) months of the date of the definitive export declaration (Declaración de Exportación), and must be brought into a local account at an IMC, sold to an IMC, or placed in a Banco de la República-registered foreign-currency account. The exporter must file Formulario No. 5 (Declaración de Cambio por Exportaciones) with the IMC, attaching the export declaration and transport/title documents. Proceeds may be retained in foreign currency without conversion, but any later disposition to Colombian residents must be executed through an IMC. Failure to repatriate within the statutory term or use of unregistered collection routes constitutes an infracción cambiaria punishable by fines up to 200% of the transaction amount.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Capital Contribution Account
Capital Escrow Account / Capital Contribution Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW (auxiliary only). Colombian foreign-exchange law does not recognize offshore digital EMIs or neobanks (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, Mercury, Payoneer) as IMCs; they cannot serve as the primary rail for channeling export proceeds or settling import obligations. Export proceeds held abroad in an unregistered EMI account breach the channeling duty and must be repatriated to an IMC within the six-month statutory term, with the external account itself registered before the Banco de la República. Offshore EMIs are tolerable only for incidental micro-collections from international distributors, provided the funds are immediately followed by a compliant SWIFT MT103 credit to the local IMC account. Using an unregistered offshore EMI as the main treasury collector is treated by Colombian IMCs as a foreign-exchange violation and an AML/KYC reputational blocker.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a foreign-owned S.A.S. classified as Medium_Risk_Enhanced in the IVD manufacturing sector, tier-1 Colombian IMCs generally require an in-person KYC interview of the local legal representative and at least one designated account signatory at a commercial bank branch (Bogotá, Medellín or Barranquilla) before activation of the operational account. Remote video-based onboarding is typically available only for low-risk domestic clients or as an additional account for an existing bank customer. Non-resident shareholders must execute a notarized and apostilled power of attorney (poder general) appointing a Colombian-based administrator or attorney-in-fact, and the bank will verify the company's Cámara de Comercio certificate, RUT, INVIMA licenses, UBO forms and screening against the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUBF) and UIAF watchlists before the account can be signed.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Excessive opacity in the foreign shareholding chain; inability to identify natural-person ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) through multiple intermediate holding entities; concentrated non-resident ownership of a high-technology manufacturing company.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle: notarized and apostilled powers of attorney; Cámara de Comercio certificates of good standing for each intermediate entity; UBO registration forms (Formato de Beneficiario Final) filed for the Colombian RUBF/UIAF database; passport copies of all natural-person UBOs; certified copy of the S.A.S. incorporation deed and shareholders register; full organizational chart with percentage interests; sworn source-of-wealth statement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Seemingly anomalous import payments to high-risk or gray-listed jurisdictions (e.g., suppliers of microfluidic polymers, biological reagents or analyzer components in Asia) disproportionate to early-stage operating scale; documentary mismatch risk on high-value trade invoices.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle: signed purchase agreements and pro-forma invoices; HS code classification (3822, 9027) and technical specifications linking goods to ISIC 3250/NAICS 334516 manufacture; DIAN import declarations and customs duty payment receipts; INVIMA import/export sanitary registrations and statutory license; certificates of origin; bills of lading or airway bills and packing lists; insurance certificates; ISO 13485 quality management certificate; CE/FDA product registration evidence; quality-control acceptance reports.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid inbound foreign capital injection followed by outbound third-party OEM or contract-manufacturer payments, raising pass-through or transit-account suspicion for a company with no visible local payroll or production footprint.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle: shareholders' capital-increase minutes approving each injection tranche; foreign-exchange declaration Formulario No. 2 evidencing registration of the foreign direct investment with the IMC and Banco de la República; OEM manufacturing agreements and full supply-chain mapping; local warehouse lease and payroll records; RUT showing CIIU 3250 economic activity; audited or pro-forma 12-month cash-flow projections; statutory accountant certification as to the commercial purpose of each disbursement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Export receipts originating from related parties or from counterparties domiciled in countries with weak AML/KYC frameworks, without an auditable link to the physical IVD goods and services exported.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle: signed distribution agreements and commercial supply contracts; Colombian Declaración de Exportación and Formulario No. 5 exchange declarations evidencing routing through the IMC; final invoices with serial numbers; packing lists and transport documents; freight-forwarding logs; sanctions, OFAC and adverse-media screening outputs for each counterparty; internal compliance certification of screening results.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived linkage to tax-haven or non-cooperative jurisdictions in the ownership chain, or sub-threshold transfer-pricing and economic-substance concerns that may cause the bank to decline the account under internal reputational risk appetite.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle: OECD/EU blacklist screening report; economic-substance documentation for each offshore holding company (premises, payroll, local directors, bank statements); Colombian tax counsel memorandum on treaty benefits and BEPS compliance; transfer-pricing documentation (master file, local file or country-by-country policy) if related-party transactions exist; audited financial statements of the ultimate beneficial owner; shareholding registry for the last two ownership tiers.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: (1) the foreign shareholder initiates a SWIFT MT103 from its own banking institution to the CO_SAS operational account at a Colombian IMC, naming the S.A.S. with its full corporate name and NIT, and referencing 'Aporte de capital social - Inversión Extranjera Directa' in the payment details; (2) the IMC verifies the certified shareholders' resolution approving the capital increase, the updated RUT and the current Cámara de Comercio certificate before accepting the funds; (3) within the registration window (the last banking day of the month following channeling), the IMC files Formulario No. 2 (Declaración de Cambio por Inversiones Internacionales) with the Banco de la República, generating the investment registration that is the legal basis for future dividend remittances and capital repatriation; (4) wire transfers exceeding USD 10,000 or the equivalent in COP activate enhanced due-diligence and same-day notification duties under the SFC rules; and (5) non-monetary capital contributions (equipment, technology, intellectual property) require a sworn independent valuation and a separate registration before being booked as paid-in capital.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfer (TT) from the local IMC account to foreign suppliers for recurring purchases of microfluidic polymers, reagents, analyzer components and laboratory consumables; and (ii) Commercial Letters of Credit (MT700/MT707) opened by the Colombian IMC in favor of the supplier bank for contract manufacturing of microfluidic cartridges and immunoassay analyzers, with sight or usance payment terms against compliant documents (commercial invoice, bill of lading, inspection or quality certificates). Before any outbound TT, the CO_SAS must hold a valid DIAN import declaration or register the remittance as an advance payment (anticipo) for goods or services; the IMC files the corresponding Declaración de Cambio (Formulario No. 4 for goods imports, Formulario No. 6 for services) and applies applicable withholding taxes (generally 15% on cross-border services and the 5% dividend withholding regime for distributions to non-residents). All LC disbursements and TT payments must remain traceable to the underlying import transaction and aligned with the customs values declared to DIAN, with full documentary retention for the five-year statute of limitations under the Colombian exchange-control and tax regimes.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: OTC US Dollar/Colombian Peso forward contracts (forwards) entered into with a licensed IMC or through an onshore IMC with an offshore bank, requiring documentary evidence of an underlying commercial exposure (trade receivables or payables) and daily mark-to-market; physical delivery of COP or net cash settlement is permissible.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDF) on USD/COP, settled in COP or in a foreign currency, available for hedging USD-denominated trade flows where physical settlement is impracticable; permitted for commercial hedging purposes under the flexibilized derivative framework of the Banco de la República.

Cross-currency swaps and FX swaps between COP and USD/EUR, permissible for transforming the currency denomination of foreign-currency debt or capital account positions, subject to the IMC's credit approval, internal limits and registration with the Banco de la República when executed onshore.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting minutes approving financial statements and filing of audited/directors financials
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) and statutory minute book
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: March 31 (within three months after fiscal year end allowed by Commercial Code Article 49)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to hold meeting and file minutes within deadline triggers restrictions on registry operations, shareholder challenge rights, and potential fines by Superintendencia de Sociedades.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renewal of Mercantile Registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Complimentary Chamber of the entity's domicile)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal surcharge; after 4 consecutive years of non-renewal, commercial registration is cancelled and the entity becomes legally inoperative; fines and prohibition from entering public procurement until regularized.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: August 9 – October 22 (assigned by last two digits of NIT; annual calendar published by DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 5% per month or fraction of the tax assessed, capped at 100%; minimum penalty of 10 UVT where no tax due; default interest accrues from the original due date.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Exogenous Information Return (Información Exógena – third-party and cross-border data)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 11 – June 10 (according to NIT last digit; annual calendar)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to 5% of the total value of omitted or erroneous information, not less than 10 UVT; penalties under Article 651 of the Tax Code.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Transfer Pricing Local File and Annual International Transactions Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same as annual corporate income tax return deadline (August – October; based on NIT digit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty up to 8,000 UVT for failure to file or for non-compliant transfer pricing documentation; associated income adjustments and 15% penalty on disputed assessment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Owner Annual Confirmation (Declaración Anual de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUBF); also reported via Chamber of Commerce
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: June 30 of each year (per Resolution 164/2022; updates also required within 1 month of any change)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to 1,500 UVT for non-compliance; refusal or delay can limit Chamber Registry operations and trigger scrutiny for anti-money-laundering compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Revisor fiscal (statutory auditor) mandatory if gross assets exceed 5,000 times the monthly legal minimum wage (approx. COP 6.5 billion in 2024, USD ~1.7M) or gross revenues exceed 3,000 times the monthly minimum wage (approx. COP 3.9 billion, USD ~1M); otherwise audit is optional but recommended for medium-risk IVD manufacturing.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Financial Reporting Standards (CTCP), classified in Grupo 1 (full IFRS) or Grupo 2 (IFRS for SMEs) depending on size and public interest; typical SAS uses NIIF para PYMES (Grupo 2).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annually disclose all final beneficial owners to DIAN via RUBF and to the Chamber of Commerce at commercial renewal. Identify natural persons holding directly or indirectly more than 10% equity or voting rights, or exercising de facto control as defined in DIAN Resolution 164/2022. Update within one month of any share transfer or control change.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors and Executive Officers
